verdict.rationale: Muse's own data policy says users can freely inspect, edit and download the files in their VM, including Muse's memory about them, which is a first-party export path for a meaningful part of user data. It is not documented as a complete export of all account data, and nothing confirms open formats or a way to close the account and leave. missing for 10: export of chat history and goals, documented open formats, a single complete export or takeout tool, an account-deletion or offboarding path, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: You can inspect, edit and download these files freely, including Muse’s memory about you.
